name: Gilgit Serena Hotel
highlight: Only true 5-star in Gilgit; garden, mountain views, free airport shuttle
pros: Consistently spacious, clean rooms and highly-rated breakfast buffet
Professional, attentive staff and free airport transfer
Beautiful garden and Karakoram views (couples rate 9.4 on Booking.com)
cons: Rates well above the local market
Reports of higher pricing quoted to foreign guests
take: Still the top choice for comfort/reliability in Gilgit; premium price is the only real drawback.

name: Madina Hotel 2
highlight: Backpacker favourite with a flower-filled garden and helpful long-time owner
pros: Clean, affordable rooms with a tranquil flower garden
Very friendly, experienced staff and good, cheap food
Close to airport terminal, ~2.6 km from city centre
cons: Inconsistent hot water reported by some guests
take: Reliable budget/backpacker pick; manage expectations on utilities but great value and hospitality.

name: Grand Continental Hotel
highlight: Quiet riverside-adjacent spot with good food and clean, spacious rooms
pros: Quiet, scenic River View Road location with helpful staff
Clean, spacious rooms and praised food
Free breakfast, WiFi and parking
cons: Small property (~15 rooms), books up fast
Basic facilities compared with the luxury tier
take: Solid mid-range value in Chinar Bagh; good for travellers wanting quiet over glitz.

name: PTDC Gilgit Motel
highlight: Old government motel with a big lawn and a well-regarded restaurant, central location
pros: Central downtown location with large lawn/garden
Good restaurant and dining service
Jeep-rental and tour services on site
cons: Ageing property needs maintenance; some bathroom/bed-bug complaints
take: Dependable central base with charm and good food, but dated  -  set expectations on upkeep.

name: Hotel Riveria
highlight: Riverside setting on River View Road with balconies and rooftop terrace
pros: Scenic location across the Gilgit River, ~0.7 mi from centre
Spacious rooms with balconies and fireplaces
Free WiFi and parking
cons: Limited/no heating; hot water only 7-10 am reported
take: Location and views are the draw; comfort is hit-or-miss, so best in warmer months.

name: MarcoPolo Hotel
highlight: Cheap, central bazaar-area rooms with basic full amenities
pros: Low nightly rate (~PKR 3,500 avg)
Spacious rooms with heater/geyser and 24-hr security
Central Khomar/Yadgar Chowk location
cons: Thin recent review base  -  quality hard to verify
Basic budget standard, no standout features
take: Fine no-frills budget option in town; corroborated as open but lightly reviewed  -  verify at booking.

name: Ramada Resort by Wyndham Gilgit
highlight: Newest international-brand resort  -  pool, spa/sauna, panoramic valley views (ADDED)
pros: Modern rooms with balconies overlooking Gilgit and the mountains
Full resort facilities: pool, spa, sauna, steam room, gym
Friendly staff and well-reviewed breakfast (couples rate 9.6)
cons: In Sakwar, a short drive out from the city centre
take: The standout newcomer  -  a genuine international-standard resort now rivaling Serena for the top spot.

name: Das-e-Basi
highlight: New 5-star with an outdoor swimming pool and garden (ADDED)
pros: One of very few Gilgit properties with an outdoor pool
Modern 5-star build with garden and restaurant
Frequently surfaced among top current Gilgit picks
cons: Still a thin published review record  -  reputation not yet established
take: Promising upscale newcomer worth watching; corroborated as open and praised but review volume is still low.
